第441章 寒冷的身躯（第1页）
“我婆婆生前算错过一次卦，导致那家人被灭门。那事之后，我婆婆就生病了，说是那家人怨恨她，诅咒了她。熬到现在才死，也是曾经的积德帮挡住的。”唐茹夜解释道。
“等等，被灭门，那也应该是怨恨杀他们的凶手，关你婆婆什么事？这啥狗屁逻辑。”柳大春无语了。
“反正我婆婆是这么说的。”唐茹夜也是很郁闷：“她死前说，这个诅咒会传到我闺女身上，没想到，临应了，她说你能救她啊？”
这唐奶奶生平就错了一次，但那一次，就是灭门之灾。
但有时候算错，也是命中注定的事。
“你婆婆真的这么准啊。但我真的不知道怎么救啊？”柳大春也是实话，这种症状，他之前也没有遇到过。
“柳医生，你就救救我闺女吧，我就这一个闺女，我什么都答应你。”唐茹夜婶婶眼泪都要出来了。
柳大春急忙扶住了她，说道：“你们先出去吧，我给看看。”
“好好。”唐茹夜点点头，和其他人就一起先出去了，顺带着关了门。
柳大春坐到床边，询问道：“你现在是什么感觉？”
“我冷，好冷，好冷。”唐婉清说道。
柳大摸她的额头，抓着她的手，都是刺骨的冰冷，这样下去，对方会失温而死的。
“你的手好暖和，好舒服。”唐婉清说道。
“是吗？我血气方刚的，阳气足，体旺，肯定暖和了。”柳大春如实回答道。
“你让我暖一暖吧，我好冷好冷。”
柳大春马上反应过来，他也是急忙钻入了被窝里，抱住了唐婉清。
唐婉清现在什么都顾不上了，只想取暖。

唐婉清把手伸入了柳大春衣服内，碰触他的肌肤。
“哇，你想冰死我啊？”柳大春被冰得都要叫出来了。
“对不起对不起，我真的太冷了。”唐婉清解释道。
“没事，你要觉得这样暖和，你就钻我怀里吧。”柳大春说着，主动把唐婉清搂抱在了怀里。
“好很多了，但还是冷。”唐婉清回答道。
“这隔着衣服没法把温度传给我吧，要不这样，咱们都脱咣，你用身体给我暖？”唐婉清主动提议道。
“我，我说错话了。”婉清红了脸，难为情的说道。
也是，柳大春又不是她的男朋友，也不是亲人，怎么能用身体温暖她呢？
“啊？不行啊。男女授受不亲的。”唐婉清都不敢看柳大春了，难为情啊，感觉自己刚才说那话，很丢脸。
“你还不同意了？吃亏的是我啊，你这么冰冷的，谁受得了啊，你以为你男朋友会愿意？你下次可以试探试探他一下。”柳大春解释道。
就是说哦，表面像是占了便宜，实际上呢，抱着这样冰冷的身体会冻死的。
“嗯，是委屈你了。”唐婉清哆嗦着说道。
“你放心吧，我只给你暖和暖和，不做其他事的，顺便看看这样对你是否有帮助。”柳大春说着就主动脱咣了自己，然后试着去脱唐婉清的衣服库子。

Chapter 441 Cold Body (Page 1)
"My mother-in-law missed a hexagram during her lifetime, which resulted in the family being exterminated. After that incident, my mother-in-law fell ill, saying that the family resented her and cursed her. She survived until now because the former Jide Gang blocked her." Tang Ruye explained.
"Wait a minute, if the family was exterminated, it should be because they were resentful of the murderer who killed them. What does it have to do with your mother-in-law? What kind of bullshit logic is this." Liu Dachun was speechless.
"That's what my mother-in-law said anyway." Tang Ruye was also very depressed: "Before she died, she said that this curse would be passed on to my daughter. Unexpectedly, Lin agreed and she said you could save her?"
This Grandma Tang made a mistake once in her life, but that time, it was the disaster of annihilation.
But sometimes miscalculation is also fate.
"Your mother-in-law is really so accurate. But I really don't know how to save her?" Liu Dachun told the truth. He had never encountered this kind of symptom before.
"Doctor Liu, please save my daughter. I am the only daughter, and I will promise you anything." Aunt Tang Ruye was about to burst into tears.
Liu Dachun hurriedly supported her and said, "You guys go out first and I'll take a look."
"Okay." Tang Ruye nodded, and went out first with the others, closing the door along the way.
Liu Dachun sat beside the bed and asked, "How do you feel now?"
"I'm cold, so cold, so cold." Tang Wanqing said.
Liu Da touched her forehead and held her hand. It was bitingly cold. If this continued, the other person would die of hypothermia.
"Your hands are so warm and comfortable." Tang Wanqing said.
"Really? I'm full of blood, full of yang energy, and strong, so I must be warm." Liu Dachun answered truthfully.
"Please let me warm up, I'm so cold."
Liu Dachun reacted immediately and hurriedly got into bed and hugged Tang Wanqing.
Tang Wanqing didn't care about anything now, she just wanted to keep warm.
Tang Wanqing put her hand into Liu Dachun's clothes and touched his skin.
"Wow, you want to freeze me to death?" Liu Dachun was so frozen that he almost cried out.
"I'm sorry, I'm really too cold." Tang Wanqing explained.
"It's okay. If you feel so warm, just get into my arms." Liu Dachun said, taking the initiative to hug Tang Wanqing in his arms.
"It's much better, but it's still cold." Tang Wanqing replied.
"You can't transmit your temperature to me through your clothes. Otherwise, we both take off our clothes and you use your body to warm me up?" Tang Wanqing suggested on her own initiative.
"I, I said the wrong thing." Wanqing blushed and said embarrassedly.
Also, Liu Dachun is not her boyfriend or a relative, so how can he warm her with his body?
"Ah? No way. Men and women cannot be intimate." Tang Wanqing didn't dare to look at Liu Dachun. She was so embarrassed and felt that what she just said was embarrassing.
"You still don't agree? It's me who suffers. You are so cold. Who can stand it? Do you think your boyfriend will be willing? You can test him next time." Liu Dachun explained.
That is to say, on the surface, it seems that I am taking advantage, but in fact, I will freeze to death if I hold such a cold body.
"Well, I have wronged you." Tang Wanqing said tremblingly.
"Don't worry, I'm just keeping you warm and not doing anything else. Let's see if this helps you." Liu Dachun took off his clothes as he spoke, and then tried to take off Tang Wanqing's clothes.
